name: List stack reveal
looks: A short list builds top to bottom, one line at a time, on the beat. Each new line lands at full weight and contrast while every earlier line desaturates to a dim secondary colour, so the eye always lands on the newest line. The final line often stays bright instead of dimming, as the payoff.
build: One DOM block of line spans; each fades/slides in (opacity 0->1, y 8px->0) on its own beat, power2.out, 0.25-0.35s. On the same beat every earlier line's colour tweens to a dim secondary (35-45% opacity or a grey token), except the last line, left at full contrast.
sound: A soft tick per line landing, slightly louder on the last.
prompt: Build a short list top to bottom, one line per beat, where each new line lands bright and every earlier line dims to a secondary colour. Let the final line hold at full brightness as the payoff.
source: a Lightspark social promo in prompt-motion.com's gallery (prompt-motion.com/davidmarcus-a28a60), studied 2026-10-09
